atoms.text: I spent my holidays at the Baltic Sea.
My parents and I got there by train.
The weather was great because it was hot.
We swam a lot and often played volleyball.

atoms.text: I stayed at my grandmother's house for one week.
On some days it was rainy, on others, the sun was shining.
Every day, we rode our bikes and painted together.

trainers.finishSound: I stayed at my grandmother's house for one week. I went there by bus. On some days it was rainy, on others, the sun was shining. Every day we rode our bikes and painted together.

instruction.text: Hilf Felix, seine Postkarte zu vervollständigen, indem du die passenden Wörter auswählst.

hint.text:
Hallo Greta!
Das Wetter in England ist mittelmäßig. Gestern war ein toller Tag. Zuerst haben wir viele interessante Sehenswürdigkeiten angeschaut. Danach aßen wir Eis in einem Park. Am Ende des Tages besuchten wir noch ein Museum mit tollen Gemälden. Ich bin gespannt auf morgen, da wollen wir Achterbahn fahren.
Bis bald!
Felix

atoms.b:
Hello Greta!
The ((++weather sun)) in England is so-so. ((++Yesterday Tomorrow)) was a great day. First, we visited lots of interesting ((++sights schools)). After that, we ((++ate eats)) ice cream in a park. At the end of the day, we ((++visited went)) a museum with great paintings. I am ((++looking_forward looking_back)) to tomorrow, we want to ride a rollercoaster.
See you ((++soon not))!
Felix
